description: Resumable production-finalization tracker for the notification-kit npm package + its new docs site. The first phase/sub-task with status 'pending' or 'in_progress' is the next thing to work on.

verifyGates.note: Package is a library — no app/device build. npm publish + docs deploy are USER-ONLY.

currentState.build: pass (2026-06-23, dual ESM+CJS, index + react entries with .d.ts)

gapInventory.title: Missing LICENSE file (package.json `files` lists it, but no file existed)
gapInventory.resolution: Added MIT LICENSE at repo root (matches package.json license). Silences npm pack warning.

gapInventory.title: Misleading 'placeholder for the API call' comments in FirebaseProvider topic subscribe/unsubscribe + callTopicAPI
gapInventory.resolution: Rewrote comments. Behavior was already correct (throws a descriptive server-side-only error for FCM topic management); only the stale 'placeholder' wording implied an unfinished feature.

gapInventory.title: README 'Current State' drift: said v2.1.0 + 'Documentation Website Coming Soon'
gapInventory.resolution: Updated to v2.1.1, refreshed gates list, and replaced 'coming soon' with the live notification-kit-docs site link.

gapInventory.title: No dedicated documentation site (only in-repo Markdown + a partial in-repo website/ Docusaurus folder)
gapInventory.resolution: Created the new PUBLIC notification-kit-docs Docusaurus site (cloned native-update-docs structure), with full source-accurate API reference, installation, configuration, platform setup, FAQ, changelog. Dual hosting config (Firebase + GitHub Pages).

gapInventory.title: FirebaseProvider client-side sendNotification / topic subscribe / getSubscriptions throw or return empty
gapInventory.reason: These are fundamental FCM platform limitations, not incomplete code: client-side send and topic (un)subscribe are privileged server-side operations (Firebase Admin SDK / IID API). The library correctly throws descriptive errors directing the caller to their backend. Implementing them client-side would require shipping admin credentials — a security anti-pattern. Documented as a limitation in the docs site.

gapInventory.title: permissions.openSettings() not implemented internally
gapInventory.reason: Deliberately not implemented to preserve the zero-dependency philosophy (opening native settings needs a native plugin). Documented; the method throws a descriptive error telling the caller to wire their own settings plugin.
